name: Icon Culture Global Company Limited
summary: Icon Culture Global Company Limited, founded in 2009 and based in Guangzhou, is an investment holding company and subsidiary of Shining Icon (BVI) Limited that offers multimedia advertising and marketing in China. Its segments are offline media advertising, online media advertising, and public relations and marketing campaigns. It places ads on television, in print, on public transport and in elevators, as well as on websites, social networks and apps, for brand owners, state-owned enterprises and government bodies.
